html:
Office window tinting is a great way to add the privacy you need for your commercial premises. Below we list the benefits of office building window tinting that make it such a wise investment.

Tint a Home is Australia’s most trusted tinting network for car, home and office window tinting. We have been providing tinting services in Australia for over 42 years. We offer a warranty of up to 15 hears for commercial applications and all installations are done by professionally trained installers. We are members of the Window Film Association of Australia and our films are government certified by ARPANSA to ensure the highest quality. Here is why office tinting is a great option for your office

The Benefits Of Office Building Window Tinting

Our range of privacy films includes darker shades but also a reflective film which is a popular choice for commercial office window tinting as it adds a modern, sleek and professional look.

The benefit of window tinting for privacy is that it stops those from the outside from seeing inside your office without decreasing the amount of natural light entering the building. And, you don’t need to worry about glare because our films reduce the amount of glare entering your office so screen reflections are minimised – great for improving productivity and a more appealing work environment!

To protect valuable equipment and create a safer environment for your staff, our safety and security films are ideal. Because they are stronger than standard films it makes glass harder to break, and if broken it holds shattered glass together. This hinders entry if a break-in is attempted and also keeps your staff safer from injury if the glass is broken accidentally.

Our films also offer protection from harmful UV rays keeping your staff safe and also helps to prevent premature fading of your office flooring and furnishings. Our decorative film is often used for office tinting.

Our decorative film is ideal for:

  • Adding privacy in bathrooms whilst still letting in natural light
  • Providing an element of style to your office with one of our designs
  • Branding – you can customise your own designs with your logo and/or brand elements.
  • Using as a divider or creating internal privacy/space

Finding Office Window Tinting Near Me

To find office window tinting near me, use our Store Finder to locate your nearest window tinting store. Call 13 TINT to speak to us if you would like more information on our office building window tinting.
